---
title: "AMD core microbes, compute prevalence tables"
date: "2026-11-09"
output: html_document
---

The slow step. Reads the recovery CSV from `01_build_manysearch_csvs.Rmd`, computes prevalence for every gate, method, and level, and writes small CSVs to `./intermediate_files/core_prevalence/`. Plots are in `03_core_prevalence_plots.Rmd`.

Rerun only when the build CSV, `gate_cuts`, `gate_min_srr`, or `recov_ih_min` changes.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
cat("tidyverse", as.character(packageVersion("tidyverse")), "loaded\n")
```

## Parameters

```{r params}
# thresholds the build CSV was made with (must match the file name)
build_gate_ih_min  <- 3
build_recov_ih_min <- 1

gate_cuts    <- c(3, 10, 20, 50)  # every gate the plot Rmd can use
gate_min_srr <- 3                 # metagenomes that must meet the gate (1 = "ANY one")
recov_ih_min <- 1                 # ih needed to keep a hit from a genome eligible for recovery
levels       <- c("species", "genus")

stopifnot(all(gate_cuts >= build_gate_ih_min), recov_ih_min >= build_recov_ih_min)

in_dir  <- "../manysearch"
in_file <- file.path(in_dir, sprintf("manysearch_gate%d_recov%d.csv",
                                     build_gate_ih_min, build_recov_ih_min))
out_dir <- "./intermediate_files/core_prevalence"

# denominator = all metagenomes, even ones with no hits
n_srr <- length(list.files(in_dir, pattern = "^SRR.*\\.csv$"))

cat(sprintf("Build CSV:  gate %d, recovery %d\n", build_gate_ih_min, build_recov_ih_min))
cat("Gates:     ", paste(gate_cuts, collapse = ", "), sprintf("ih in >= %d metagenome(s)\n", gate_min_srr))
cat(sprintf("Recovery:   >= %d ih\n", recov_ih_min))
cat("Levels:    ", paste(levels, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Output:    ", out_dir, "\n")
```

## 1. Load the recovery CSV

```{r load}
if (!file.exists(in_file)) stop('"', in_file, '" not found. Run 01_build_manysearch_csvs.Rmd first.')

in_path  <- normalizePath(in_file)
in_mtime <- file.mtime(in_file)

# skip the read if recovered is already in memory from this exact file version
already_loaded <- exists("recovered") &&
                  exists("recovered_src") && identical(recovered_src, in_path) &&
                  exists("recovered_mtime") && identical(recovered_mtime, in_mtime)

if (already_loaded) {
  cat(sprintf('"%s" not reloaded, already in memory (last built %s)\n',
              in_path, format(in_mtime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")))
} else {
  recovered <- read_csv(in_file,
                        col_types = cols(query_name = "c", match_name = "c",
                                         intersect_hashes = "d", species = "c"),
                        show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(genus = word(str_trim(query_name), 2))

  recovered_src   <- in_path
  recovered_mtime <- in_mtime
  cat(sprintf('"%s" loaded (last built %s)\n',
              in_path, format(in_mtime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")))
}

taxa_key <- distinct(recovered, query_name, species, genus)

cat(format(nrow(recovered), big.mark = ","), "rows\n")
cat(nrow(taxa_key), "genomes,",
    n_distinct(taxa_key$species), "species,",
    n_distinct(taxa_key$genus), "genera\n")
cat(n_distinct(recovered$match_name), "of", n_srr, "metagenomes have hits\n")
```

## 2. Prevalence functions

`eligible_at(h)` returns the genomes that meet `h` ih in at least `gate_min_srr` metagenomes. The result is cached per gate, so the full table is scanned once per gate instead of once per `prevalence_at()` call. Rerunning this chunk clears the cache.

```{r prevalence-fns}
eligible_cache <- list()

eligible_at <- function(h) {
  key <- as.character(h)
  if (is.null(eligible_cache[[key]])) {
    eligible_cache[[key]] <<- recovered %>%
      filter(intersect_hashes >= h) %>%
      distinct(query_name, match_name) %>%
      count(query_name) %>%
      filter(n >= gate_min_srr) %>%
      pull(query_name)
  }
  eligible_cache[[key]]
}

prevalence_at <- function(h, recover = TRUE, level = "species") {
  d <- if (recover) {
    recovered %>% filter(query_name %in% eligible_at(h), intersect_hashes >= recov_ih_min)
  } else {
    recovered %>% filter(intersect_hashes >= h)
  }
  d %>%
    distinct(taxon = .data[[level]], match_name) %>%
    count(taxon, name = "n_present") %>%
    mutate(freq = n_present / n_srr,
           gate_ih = h,
           level = level,
           method = if (recover) "recovered" else "strict only") %>%
    arrange(desc(freq))
}

for (h in gate_cuts) {
  e <- eligible_at(h)
  cat(sprintf("gate %2d: %d of %d genomes eligible for recovery (%d species, %d genera)\n",
              h, length(e), nrow(taxa_key),
              n_distinct(taxa_key$species[taxa_key$query_name %in% e]),
              n_distinct(taxa_key$genus[taxa_key$query_name %in% e])))
}
```

## 3. Prevalence grid

Every gate, both methods, both levels.

```{r prevalence-grid}
t0 <- Sys.time()

prevalence_grid <- expand_grid(h = gate_cuts, recover = c(TRUE, FALSE), level = levels) %>%
  pmap(\(h, recover, level) prevalence_at(h, recover, level)) %>%
  list_rbind()

cat(format(nrow(prevalence_grid), big.mark = ","), "rows in prevalence_grid, computed in",
    round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))), "seconds\n")
prevalence_grid %>% count(level, method, gate_ih, name = "n_taxa") %>% print(n = Inf)
```

## 4. Diagnostics

These need the full table, so they stay here.

```{r diagnostics}
cat("Denominator check (freq should never exceed 1)\n")
cat("  n_srr:", n_srr, "| metagenomes with hits:", n_distinct(recovered$match_name),
    "| freq range:", paste(round(range(prevalence_grid$freq), 3), collapse = " to "), "\n")

cat("\nName parsing\n")
cat("  NA species:", sum(is.na(taxa_key$species)),
    "| NA genus:", sum(is.na(taxa_key$genus)), "\n")
cat("  First 5 genome names\n")
writeLines(paste("   ", head(taxa_key$query_name, 5)))

cat("\nMost reference genomes per species (pooling inflates these)\n")
taxa_key %>% count(species, sort = TRUE, name = "n_genomes") %>% head(10) %>% print()

cat("\nMost reference genomes per genus\n")
taxa_key %>% count(genus, sort = TRUE, name = "n_genomes") %>% head(10) %>% print()

cat("\nRecovered rows by ih bin\n")
recovered %>% count(ih_bin = cut(intersect_hashes, c(0, 2, 9, 19, 49, Inf))) %>% print()

cat("\nAre 1-2 ih hits everywhere? (if most genomes hit most metagenomes this way, it's noise)\n")
noise <- recovered %>%
  filter(intersect_hashes < 3) %>%
  distinct(query_name, match_name) %>%
  count(query_name) %>%
  summarize(median_srrs = median(n),
            frac_genomes_in_90pct = mean(n >= 0.9 * n_srr))
cat(sprintf("  median metagenomes per genome: %.0f of %d | genomes in >= 90%% of metagenomes: %.1f%%\n",
            noise$median_srrs, n_srr, noise$frac_genomes_in_90pct * 100))
```

## 5. Write intermediate files

```{r write}
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

run_params <- tibble(
  n_srr, gate_min_srr, recov_ih_min, build_gate_ih_min, build_recov_ih_min,
  gate_cuts    = paste(gate_cuts, collapse = ";"),
  levels       = paste(levels, collapse = ";"),
  source_file  = in_path,
  source_mtime = format(in_mtime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
  computed     = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
)

write_csv(prevalence_grid, file.path(out_dir, "prevalence_grid.csv"))
write_csv(run_params,      file.path(out_dir, "run_params.csv"))

for (f in c("prevalence_grid.csv", "run_params.csv")) {
  p <- file.path(out_dir, f)
  cat(sprintf('"%s" written (%s bytes)\n', normalizePath(p), format(file.size(p), big.mark = ",")))
}
```

## Cleanup

```{r cleanup}
# everything the plot Rmd needs is on disk, so drop it all (add "recovered" to keep it between runs)
keep <- c()
dropped <- setdiff(ls(), keep)
rm(list = dropped)
gc(verbose = FALSE)
cat("Removed", length(dropped), "objects\n")
```
